Quick summary

HERE WeGo’s latest mobile update improves public transport route planning and makes transit guidance clearer on in-car displays, reinforcing the app’s position as a multimodal navigation tool rather than a car-only GPS.

Key takeaways

  • HERE WeGo released version 4.19.300 for iOS and Android
  • The update focuses on better public transport route planning
  • Transit directions are now presented more clearly on vehicle displays
  • The release also includes routine bug fixes and reliability improvements
  • The product positioning emphasizes multimodal navigation across walking, transit, and driving
